# Lakeside Waste Collection Schedule

TEST FIXTURE ONLY. Synthetic text written for software evaluation; it is not part of any real corpus.

## 1 Collection days

In Service Area North household bins are collected on Mondays. In Service Area South household bins are collected on Wednesdays. In Service Area East household bins are collected on Fridays.

## 2 Garden waste

Garden waste is collected every second week from April to October.
